pll1d15c2-d1e3477.summary: Asks how the mission of Son and Spirit is to be understood, since, with Augustine, only Son and Spirit, never the Father, are said to be sent. Starting with the Son: 'God sent his Son made of a woman' (Gal 4:4) shows that the Son was sent in being made of a woman, which the Father did not do without the Spirit, so the Son was sent by Father and Spirit.
claims: The Father is never said to be sent.
The Son's being sent is his being made of a woman.
The Son was sent by the Father and the Spirit.

pl-l1d15c2.summary: Asks how the missions of Son and Spirit are to be understood, noting with Augustine that the Father is never said to be sent. Taking the Son first: by Galatians 4:4 he was sent in being made of a woman. Since the Father did this together with the Spirit, the Son was sent by the Father and the Spirit.
claims: The Father is never said to be sent.
The Son was sent in being made of a woman.
The Son was sent by the Father and the Holy Spirit.
